# portainer_team_memberships (Data Source)

Lists the members of a team and identifies its leaders.

## Example Usage

```hcl
data "portainer_team_memberships" "platform" {
  team_id = portainer_team.platform.id
}

output "platform_leaders" {
  value = data.portainer_team_memberships.platform.leader_user_ids
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `team_id` (Number) Identifier of the team whose members are listed.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Identifier of the data source, `<team_id>/memberships`.
- `leader_user_ids` (List of Number) Identifiers of the team's leaders, who may manage its membership.
- `memberships` (List of Object) Members of the team. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--memberships))

<a id="nestedatt--memberships"></a>
### Nested Schema for `memberships`

Read-Only:

- `id` (Number)
- `role` (Number)
- `user_id` (Number)

## Notes on Arguments and Attributes

- `memberships`: Each entry has `id`, `user_id` and `role` (1 = team leader, 2 = team member).
